name: Dong Xuan Market
kicker: Covered market at the north end

Travel.com.vn says stall hours can change and that entry has no ticket. Dan Tri prints no fee. The lake-to-market distance is printed as both about 800 m and about 2 km. body: The market is the covered hall at the north end of the lanes. The front carries the name Chợ Đồng Xuân. Dan Tri describes three floors, with clothes and accessories on the ground floor and a dry-goods area called Bac Qua. Travel.com.vn places it on Dong Xuan street, Hoan Kiem, and puts the management office at 1A Cau Dong.

Dan Tri prints 06:00–18:00 every day, and 22:30 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Travel.com.vn says stall hours can change, especially around holidays or while the hall is being repaired, and that you should check before you go. Travel.com.vn also says there is no entry ticket, and that shopping and food are paid separately. Dan Tri does not print a fee. Treat the entry price as check on arrival until the door confirms it.

The walk from the lake is not one number. Dan Tri prints about 2 km from Hoan Kiem. Travel.com.vn prints about 800 m. Neither page is a measured minute count you can bank. Minutes: check on arrival. Inside, the cloth stalls are the frame people recognize. Wholesale goods are the point of the hall more than a souvenir list.

gettingThere: Walk north from Hoan Kiem Lake through the lanes to Dong Xuan street. Dan Tri prints about 2 km. Travel.com.vn prints about 800 m. No operator page printed a minute count. Minutes: check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem Lake
legs.body: Walk north. Dan Tri prints about 2 km to the market. Travel.com.vn prints about 800 m. Minutes: check on arrival.

hours: Dan Tri, 27 Oct 2023: 06:00–18:00 every day, and until 22:30 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Travel.com.vn: stall hours can change and should be checked before you go.
closed: Dan Tri prints every day of the week. No weekly close is printed on that page.
admissionNote: Travel.com.vn states there is no entry ticket. Shopping, food, and other services are paid separately. Dan Tri does not print a fee. Confirm at the door. No stall price is printed here.
